headline: Granules India Posts Record Q2 Revenue Amid Margin Pressure
summary: Granules India recorded record revenue for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 while experiencing ongoing margin pressure.
why: Granules India is a pharmaceutical manufacturer whose results reflect cost and pricing dynamics in the generics sector.

impacts.name: Granules India
impacts.why: Record revenue balanced against margin pressure creates mixed trading signals for investors.
